purpose: Archive the bounded native function-call adapter for partial native record windows, including already-partial views and the bounded single-view fallback when appropriate.
scope: The partial-record proposal path and deterministic regression checks pass. The actual city-resume browser workflow reached the official BART page through a verified native link but ended unableToComplete after a local capacity gate rejected final-page planning. The exact rejected request and which capacity gate rejected it are not captured, so this is not attributed to page size, token count, or a specific planner path. This is not end-to-end task acceptance or model qualification. The full-page JSON-schema path remains first; the native function adapter is limited to partial native record views.

interface.protocol: One required native function call, parallel calls disabled, 768-token response budget. Functions are openLink, search, askUser, wait, inspectRecords (same captured page only), and incomplete.
interface.partialRecordRules: The adapter cannot return answer or visualFallback. Every retained goal-contract requirement is emitted pending with empty evidence; tool calls represent one proposed next operation and cannot mark requirements complete.
interface.referenceRules: openLink references are limited to user URLs and links in the selected record window; inspectRecords references are limited to adjacent views of the same captured page. The strict decoder checks the selected function and exact argument shape, bounds each string argument, then passes the normalized proposal through the retained-step decoder.
interface.unchangedPath: The full-page JSON-schema request remains the first path; this adapter is only selected after the page is partitioned into record windows. The focused fixture asserts that the full-page request still uses browser_retained_step and JSON schema.
interface.authorityBoundary: The partial request removes optional workerDirective and specialistCompletion fields, along with the duplicated goal/clarifications, before constructing the tool-result context.

The actual city-resume run asks for the missing city, preserves the typed answer and original task, selects verified native link l11, and reaches the official BART page.
